title: The studio key clipped to a blank rundown
body: The keyring is clipped to a blank page in the studio desk. The only pencilled line says “doors locked”; the box for who checked them is empty.
rival_reading: A broadcast worker could secure the studio before any emergency and leave the checklist unfinished; the blank box does not prove a failed containment order.
gloss: A locked studio and an unsigned check remain on the same page.

title: The field sketch under the studio glass
body: The notebook is trapped beneath a glass desk cover. A crop-row sketch has a water stain across its centre; the bottle beside it is dry and capped.
rival_reading: A reporter could sketch field reports and spill water while working; neither the stain nor the drawing identifies a program.
gloss: A field sketch and a water mark sit under the studio desk glass.
